title: Figure 25: Cylinder CFD Mach number contour at 1500 mph
description: Color CFD contour plot of a flat-ended cylinder at 1/6 scale with a Mach number color legend, showing a low-speed wake behind the body within a high-Mach flow field. The caption reads "Figure 25. Cylinder Mach Number at 1/6 Scale, Air Temperature 223K and 1500 mph with Supersonic Inlet and Supersonic Outlet." Below it, section 4.1.4 summarizes the compressible numerical analyses of the "Tic Tac" geometry, describing detached shock waves from 700 mph up to 1,500 mph.
